desc: ENABLER, do this first if any tethered smoke is wanted. The m1n1 volume currently has the dual-mode object b409d89e enrolled, which boots Alpine after a 10 s window — so there is NO m1n1 proxy to chainload into over KIS, and KIS is the only transport that can observe a console=tty0/ttydc0 image (the USB gadget cannot; see evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-ubuntu-untethered-object.md). Enroll a payload-free, proxy-capable object from 1TR so agents can run tethered chainload smokes without further maintainer involvement: rollback-m1n1-1394c345.bin (1394c345..., the live-proven bare upper-guard) or probe-window60-bare.bin (62394006...). Both are 16 KiB-aligned and reach 'Running proxy'. Afterwards an agent can smoke any object with scripts/t6040-boot-raw-object.sh over M1N1DEVICE=/tmp/m1n1. Restore the dual-mode object b409d89e when daily-driver use resumes. Maintainer-executed (kmutil is 1TR-only).
author: claude
result: 2026-07-26: SATISFIED. Maintainer enrolled rollback-m1n1-1394c345.bin (1394c345, bare upper-guard proxy loader). Confirmed live: cold boot reaches 'Running proxy' and the proxyclient attaches on /dev/cu.usbmodemJ22GYCN4YG1 (target-type J614s, Mac16,8, ADT 0x94000 fetched, 'No valid payload found' => payload-free as required). Tethered KIS smokes 147/148/149 are now unblocked. Restore dual-mode object b409d89e when daily-driver use resumes.
